changelog:
Unified CSM confirmation, selection and input dialogs with CloudStream theme roles, typography and spacing.
Applied shared styling to modern, legacy and default AndroidX preference dialogs.
Kept host native dialog backgrounds; uses a Material shape only when host resources are unavailable.
Aligned login, chat, provider settings, runtime tools and system pickers with the host theme.
Preserved listener-vetoed preference changes, cancel drafts, callbacks, selection and input behavior.
Protected faithful content previews and diagnostic monospace formatting from generic restyling.
Added dialog coverage, lifecycle, choice-state and persistence regression tests.
message: CloudStream dialog styling and behavior contracts renewed
